name: OpenCode harness for the agent sandbox
description: OpenCode as a harness of the agent-sandbox feature: the harness definition and its config hook (the local model, the Workbench MCP server when the policy allows it), the `opencode` command that always starts OpenCode in the sandbox, and the Dockerfile of the sandbox image the app's compose file builds.

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user.

installLauncher.description: Install the `opencode` command (false on the sandbox-broker, which only needs the harness files).
